name: lake
desc: A gentle young man in his late twenties: the village lamplighter. Tousled wavy brown hair, soft warm brown eyes, a warm boyish friendly face, a calm kind manner. He wears a FITTED knee-length charcoal dark-grey HOODED COAT (hood down at the back of the neck), closed down the front and belted snugly at the waist with a brown leather belt, so the coat follows the line of his torso and hips. It has proper set-in SLEEVES on both arms ending at the wrists. A small brass flame-shaped clasp at the throat. Under it a white band-collar shirt and a dark green vest with cord X-lacing. Brown pants, brown boots. No chest strap, no bag, nothing held in either hand. Every part of the garment stays close against the body — no loose panel floats clear of him.
sheetHint: same face, tousled wavy brown hair, warm boyish late-twenties face, fitted knee-length charcoal hooded coat belted at the waist with proper sleeves on both arms, brass flame-shaped clasp at the throat, white band-collar shirt and green X-laced vest beneath, brown pants, brown boots, no chest strap, hands empty

expressions.happy: a bright open smile, eyes lit up
expressions.worried: brows knit, small anxious frown, eyes glancing aside
expressions.determined: firm set jaw, focused eyes, faint confident smirk
expressions.tender: soft eyes, small warm smile, head fractionally tilted — the look of giving someone their name back

turnaround.extraNote: THE GARMENT IS A FITTED BELTED COAT, NOT A CAPE, and this is a MODELLING requirement rather than a style preference (2026-08-02, measured — see _capeVerdict). Sleeves are set-in on both arms so the arms bind to the ARM joints. The skirt below the belt hangs around the LEGS, which is the correct joint for a skirt to follow. Nothing stands clear of the body in silhouette from any view.

_capeVerdict: 2026-08-02, tools/char_intake.py on the first Tripo delivery. The swept-back cape FAILED to bind: cape panel A 85.9% arm-weighted, panel B 67.1% arm / 27.7% leg, at 7,714 and 6,789 verts (the largest sheet region on any shipped model is Vesper's collar at 1,610). Cause: an auto-rigger binds each vertex to the NEAREST joint, and the cape hung ~35 cm clear of the body, where nothing near it is the spine — under a stride it scissored with the limbs. The swept-back decision itself was VINDICATED in the same pass (arms separate closed loops at 42-52%, same as Finn; both hands 100% clean), so the fix is narrower than a redesign: keep the pose, keep the hood and the charcoal silhouette, close the garment against the body. All five shipped bodies wear coats and all five bind acceptably. The cut-in portraits KEEP the front-draped cape by design — a portrait never animates, and a portrait and a walk cycle want different silhouettes. Retired art: public/assets/characters/lake/turnaround-cape-retired/.
_lookNote: Identity ratified 2026-08-02 from public/assets/refs/lake.jpeg (user pick: base candidate 3). The turnaround front is a direct render in the house style (soft painterly toon, ~5 heads, Vesper A-pose anchor) and left/right/back are chained off it, so all four views share ONE anchor. Note when re-rolling: 4 of 5 exploratory rolls conditioned on bust.png drifted to semi-photoreal ~7-head adults — chaining off an already-on-model A-pose is a far stronger style pin than any prose.
